related.title: At least 10 killed in Kyiv as Zelenskyy warns of ‘massive Russian strike’
related.summary: The Russian Defence Ministry said in a post on Telegram on Thursday that it carried out a “massive attack” on Kyiv and other locations using long-range, high-precision air-, land- and sea-launched weapons and drones. The ministry said it hit military and energy facilities around Kyiv, as well as military airports in several regions including Poltava and Dnipropetrovsk, in what it called retaliation for Ukraine’s attack on civilian infrastructure.

related.summary: Yaroslavl, Russia — A Ukrainian drone strike on the Kombinat Temp oil storage facility in Rybinsk destroys 15 fuel tanks 15 Jun. Russian strikes killed at least 60 civilians in the Donetsk, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Sumy, Kherson, Zaporizhia, and Odesa regions, as well as in Kyiv city. In Moscow city, Ukrainian drones, as well as the Russian air defense system missiles that were activated to intercept these drones, struck the Moscow Oil Refinery on 15 and 18 June, engulfing the city in black smoke.
